reason: B adds a coherent TCR/CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition theme (and Treg/FOXP3 at the top level), the core T-cell activation context of IL-2 that A lacks, which outweighs B's extra STAT5/EPO/FLT3 near-duplicates.

Both sets give the same urate, SLC22 organic-anion, hexose and renal amino-acid transport contexts, but B piles on near-duplicate transporter themes and a loosely related carbohydrate/glycogen-metabolism theme without adding a real facet.

Only A reaches an extracellular ligand-sequestration theme containing negative regulation of FGF receptor signaling (plus BMP/NODAL), the sole context relevant to betaglycan's FGF2 role, whereas B stays entirely on TGF-beta/activin/SMAD cancer-mutant themes.

A has a small, tight ureteric bud/ureter/mesonephric duct theme matching the collecting duct's ureteric-bud origin, while B's small themes are nephron-segment (distal tubule, loop of Henle) patterning and the ureteric bud only appears in a broad 27-member theme, though A is more redundant.

A keeps a compact gas-exchange theme with oxygen transport and reversible CO2 hydration (carbonic anhydrase), central to red-cell O2/CO2 exchange and absent from B, despite A carrying some noisy vitamin C, peptide-transporter and metal-ion themes.

B covers the same organic-anion facets (drug/SLCO-SLC22 ADME, di/tricarboxylate and monocarboxylate carriers, mitochondrial shuttle, urate, bilirubin, carnitine) with far fewer near-duplicate ADME and carnitine themes, while A's extras add little beyond a bile-acid secretion variant.
